method: Read-only saved-output diagnostics, no new inference or fitting

saved_sigmoid_audit.interpretation: Saved probabilities match sigmoid(raw_logodds); no observed sigmoid arithmetic error. This does not audit all semantic endpoint/rendering choices.

interpretation: Large class-conditional score-scale shift on external data; preserved useful ranking on StepGuard/Dojo/R-Judge but not ATBench. Content-domain, rendering/role and label-task shifts are not isolated here.
hypotheses_not_established_causes: Soft token-curve BCE is not hard-label endpoint probability training; each endpoint has only one token contribution in its action-averaged objective.
Training source and class imbalance may promote source-specific shortcuts or a conservative low-score default.
Structured multi-agent training and opaque-string benchmark contexts differ even under the same native template.
Endpoint ranking constrains order, not absolute scale; low thresholds also occur without ranking.
proposals_not_executed: Audit matched semantic inputs/rendering and action endpoints before new training.
